page.layout: Two-line running head at top with page number, one block of running text in a single column, with two marginal notes in the left margin, the first in roman type and the second in black letter.
page.running_head: De Agro Fris. inter Lavic. & Amas.

main_text.p: amnis, ubi Delfsilæus portus & castellum, milliare dimidium ; vallo, fossâ, portis quondam munita ab Edsardo ante annos centum, & triennio post à Georgio Saxone civitatis quoque jure atque ordine magistratuum donata ; sed his ab eodem post annos xii, illis à Geldro anno sequente rursus exuta nudataque ; à Tautenburgio demùm Burgundicæ militiæ duce anno m. d. xxxv i excidio damnata, & vix precibus suorum incolumis conservata. Ipsa caput quondam Fivelgoniæ : à cujus Ordinibus jura ejus qualiacunque ac statuta vetera, per manus accepta, & in more posita, quæ privilegia sua Dam-monenses vocant, solenni in conventu, anno post Natalem Christi m. ccc.xxvii Litera de iureDam-monēsium, vulgòdiēt [?]recensa probataque, & mox paucos post dies ab omnibus quoque Frisiis in comitiis universægentis ad Vpstallefbomum confirmata esse,in Historia exposui. In statutis his hæc reperio, Dammonam, ut de Buer bzieff bā den Dā.nunc habet, ita tunc habuisse judices suos ex in-digenis lectos: his finito muneris sui tempore (triennie id esse solet) cum primario loci sacerdote jus suisse, die xxii Februarij suc-cessores

page.notes: Left margin, first note: "Litera de / iureDam- / monēsium, / vulgòdiēt" was read as one line; the last word is uncertain and marked [?]. Second note is in black letter ("de Büer / bzieff bā / den Dā."); its letters are doubtful, notably "Büer" and "Dā", and the transcription is a best reading. Placement of both notes within the paragraph follows their height beside the text lines. The date "xxii" and the spelling "Vpstallefbomum" are copied as printed; the date numeral may be read as xxii. The text is one paragraph with no indent at the start, continuing from the previous page, and the last line "suc-cessores" is the printed continuation of the word. No catchword or signature is printed.
